hook_text: Undefeated at hide and seek since this

song.title: Can't Find Me
song.style: English, playful surf rock, twangy guitar, bouncy bass, tambourine, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, whoa-oh backing vocals, 128 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Kids are counting up to ten
Used to buzz and lose again
Tucked my phone in orange tight
Not a peep and out of sight

[Chorus]
Can't find me, can't find me
Up a tree as quiet as can be
Can't find me, can't find me
Hide and seek champion, that's me

shots.prompt: {moss} tiptoes away with big exaggerated sneaky steps while a group of kids cover their eyes against a big tree, counting. Static wide shot. Bright sunny park light.
{moss} crouches behind a bush, then jumps in surprise as the kids pop up around him pointing and laughing. Static medium shot. Bright sunlight.

A hand gently slides a black smartphone all the way down into a slim terracotta-orange sleeve standing upright on a soft cream studio backdrop, until the phone disappears inside and only the rounded thumb notch at the top remains. A small closed-eye emblem is pressed into the front of the sleeve. The hand pulls away and the sleeve stands still, casting a soft shadow. Static close-up, the light slowly turns warmer.
{moss} climbs a chunky tree and settles among the leaves with a finger on his lips. The camera tilts up with him. Dappled sunlight.
Kids search under a picnic table and behind a fence, scratching their heads. Static wide shot. Warm afternoon light.
{moss} peeks out between the leaves, holding back giggles under his mustache. Static close-up. Dappled green light.
{moss} sits silently on a branch next to a squirrel, both perfectly still. Static medium shot. Soft afternoon light.
{moss} drops down from the tree with his arms raised in victory as the kids cheer and jump around him. Static wide shot. Golden light.
{moss} shares ice cream cones with the kids on a park bench at sunset. The camera slowly pulls back. Peach and gold, calm.

caption: Moss used to lose every round because his phone buzzed. Now it's tucked in an Eyelid and he is unbeatable.
